skill_name: Summarize the events in the story below in 3-4 sentences.
workflow: Princess Rose had a magical gift of singing and was determined to use it to protect her people from a dark wizard. She ventured into the forest to find a magical flower that would help her stop the wizard, and after a treacherous journey, she succeeded in finding it. With the flower in hand, Rose returned to her kingdom with the hope of saving it.
